readme:
# Twitter (X) User Profile API

Pass an X screen name (or numeric user ID) and get the account's public profile and counts.

## Use cases

- Vet influencers and partners.
- Track follower growth.
- Resolve handles to stable user IDs.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/twitter/web/user-profile" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"screen_name": "NASA"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rest_id` | integer | No | User ID, for example: 44196397, if the user ID is used, the username will be ignored, only one of them can be selected. |
| `screen_name` | string | No | Screen Name, for example: elonmusk, can be obtained from the user's homepage link, for example: elonmusk in https://twi… |

## Example response

Real response for the request above, trimmed to the main fields. User names and long IDs are masked.

```json
{
  "blue_verified": true,
  "desc": "Making the seemingly impossible, possible. ✨",
  "id": "11348282",
  "media_count": 28179,
  "name": "NASA",
  "rest_id": "11348282",
  "status": "active",
  "statuses_count": 74382,
  "sub_count": 92374842,
  "verification_type": "Government"
}
```

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Twitter (X) Search](/model/twitter/web/search-timeline): Search Twitter / X posts by keyword and get tweets with text, author, time and engagement counts (likes, retweets, replies, views).
- [Twitter (X) Trending Topics](/model/twitter/web/trending): Get trending topics on Twitter / X by country: trend names with their category context, for the United States, Japan, India, the UK and other markets.
- [Twitter Tweet Detail](/model/twitter/web/tweet-detail): Get a single tweet (X post) by ID: full text, author, media, and like, retweet, reply, quote, bookmark and view counts.
